verses.1: A psalm of the Korahites. A song. The LORD loves the city founded on holy mountains,
verses.2: Loves the gates of Zion more than any dwelling in Jacob.
verses.3: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God! Selah
verses.4: From Babylon and Egypt I count those who acknowledge the LORD. Philistia, Ethiopia, Tyre, of them it can be said: "This one was born there."
verses.5: But of Zion it must be said: "They all were born here." The Most High confirms this;
verses.6: the Lord notes in the register of the peoples: "This one was born here." Selah
verses.7: So all sing in their festive dance: "Within you is my true home."

notes.text: The gates: the city itself, a common Hebrew idiom.
The bond between the exile and the holy city was so strong as to override the exile's citizenship of lesser cities.
